TPI LUX / service 07

Ventilation and air conditioning systems

We design and install climate systems for buildings, public spaces and infrastructure sites: ventilation, air conditioning, VRF/VRV, fan coils and servicing.

Discuss a project See scope of work
The TPI LUX principle Operation and energy efficiency

Climate systems are selected with long-term operation, stable performance and sensible energy consumption in mind.

Scope of work

What this service covers

The outline is drawn from working material and presented here in the format of a commercial page.

Ventilation systems

Supply, extract and supply-and-extract units, and air distribution systems.

Climate system design

Analysis of the building parameters, air exchange calculations, equipment selection and design documentation.

Air conditioning

Split systems, multi-split, ducted units, VRF and VRV systems.

Equipment supply

Selection for the needs of the site, arranging deliveries, quality checks and preparation for installation.

Fan coils and chillers

Centralised cooling and climate control for offices, shopping centres, hotels and public premises.

Installation and service

Installation of units, ductwork, air conditioners and fan coils, commissioning, diagnostics and servicing.

Engineering accountability

Why TPI LUX

A complete approach to the project: concept, design, procurement, installation, commissioning and maintenance under a single responsibility.

The team works on large sites where deadlines, safety, quality control and clear communication matter.

Solutions are chosen for the site and for how it will be run, not only for how it looks on day one.
